_axes: Roblox studs: X = Blender X, Y = up (Blender Z), Z = -Blender Y. 'center' is the middle of each mesh's box, measured from the model origin (bottom centre of the footprint, on the floor).
_front: Front faces Roblox -Z (Blender +Y): CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + faceDirection) points it.
_notes: Replaces SpawnRing and SpawnDisc. 11 across, 0.38 high. Origin on the plaza floor at the spawn point (0, 0, 34); turn it so the star points at the pads (front = -Z after lookAt towards the pads).

SpawnPad_Body.note: red rim, white disc, embossed gold star (one point towards +Y = front)
